data.name: Shadowy Specialization
data.description: When a shadowcaster casts shades, shadow conjuration, shadow evocation, and similar illusion spells that have a listed fraction of the strength of real effects, he increases the percentage of damage caused by the spell's effect or summoned creatures by one-fifth (+20%%) against creatures that make their saving throws against the effect, up to a maximum of 100%% of the strength. For example, shadow evocation and shadow conjuration deal 40%% normal damage on a successful save instead of 20%%.
